title: Mirror context superposition for task models
hypothesis: Learned diagonal or orthogonal task Mirror views over one shared physical matrix recover related task functions with lower bytes than independent matrices and improve on fixed PSP contexts and byte-near low-rank residuals.
physical_object: One shared D x O linear-map matrix
mirror_coordinate: Task-specific learned output diagonal gain or matrix-free Givens rotation code

task.family: shared base matrix plus task-specific structured output transforms

controls: native PSP fixed Rademacher contexts with unbinding
shared matrix + learned task-specific diagonal gain
shared matrix + learned task-specific Givens orthogonal output transform

development.selection_metric: mean held-out task MSE across all methods

storage.authority: actual torch.save inference payload plus canonical JSON metadata
paid_objects: PSP superposed matrix and deterministic context seed metadata

success_gate: Mirror per-task heldout MSE <=1.10x independent, payload <=50% independent, and >=10% lower mean MSE than PSP and lowrank at byte-near payload (within 15%) or strictly lower bytes.
failure_gate: Mirror misses quality/byte gate or PSP/lowrank matches it at equal/lower bytes.
boundaries: fixed-update screen is not capacity proof
no language quality or fixed-byte near-convergence frontier

amendments.reason: Code audit found initial PSP implementation did not encode task-specific target matrices: it reused the shared parameter as every bound item and serialized a duplicated context buffer.
amendments.change: PSP control now directly trains one physical superposed tensor; inference sign-unbinds a fixed seeded Rademacher context, with context deterministically reconstructed from the paid seed metadata. Development screen is rerun from scratch under the same world/seed and LR candidates.
amendments.scope: Only native PSP control implementation and paid context storage representation; other methods and all seeds/gates unchanged.
